about: Narration placement for Phase 01. 'src' = seconds in public/audio/narration.m4a (the narrator's recording, loudness-normalised). 'at' = film second where the segment's src start lands. Word times come from src/data/narration_transcript.json (speech recognition, verified against the approved script).

segments.note: When Life Doesn't Go as Planned · Deeply Rooted · Episode One
Have you ever looked at your life… and wondered how you ended up here?
Not because everything is terrible. But because…
this isn't where you thought you would be.
You had dreams. You imagined a different version of yourself by now.
